submission.justification: Mixture-G3 with a 2mm gas gap delivers the best time resolution of 0.903 ns across all tested configurations. This represents a significant performance improvement of 29.1% over Mixture-G1 and 52.6% over Mixture-G2 at their respective optimal configurations. The simulation systematically evaluated all three candidate mixtures at gaps of 1mm, 2mm, and 3mm. For Mixture-G3, the 2mm gap provides optimal performance, outperforming both the 1mm configuration (0.982 ns) and the 3mm configuration (1.067 ns). All compliance requirements have been verified: the mixture meets the laboratory's environmental and safety policies with 90% gas recovery capability, the 2mm gap falls within the specified 1-3mm constraint, and the mixture is confirmed as available. This configuration achieves the stated goal of best possible time resolution while satisfying all operational constraints.
